subject: SOC 2 Type II request — audit period clarification & secure transfer plan
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Nguyen <amelia.nguyen@acmecloud.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report & bridge options — audit period clarification

Hi Amelia,

Hope you’re well. We’re kicking off procurement for a paid integration with Acme and need your most recent SOC 2 Type II report and any bridge-letter options you can provide. Specifically we’re trying to confirm coverage for our target audit window (calendar year 2027). Can you confirm your Type II report audit period (start / end dates) and whether you can provide a bridge letter to show continued coverage through 2027 if the report period ends earlier?

To speed things along, we generally accept the following artifacts when available:
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
- Bridge letter / management assertion (PDF)
- Control matrices / evidence index (xlsx)
- Redacted policy snapshots (PDF)

Preferred secure transfer options (we can accept one):
- Encrypted S3 presigned link (preferred)
- Secure SharePoint or Box shared folder (company-managed)
- Managed SFTP with account credentials (short-lived)

I’ve attached a short intake template to indicate the items that are most useful for our review (SOC2_Evidence_Request_Template.xlsx) and a one-page transfer instructions note (transfer_instructions.txt). If you need a standard NDA/DP addendum before transfer, let me know — we can escalate.

Target timing: we’d like to have the report and bridge letter (if applicable) by COB next Wednesday (2028-03-08) to meet our security review cycle. If that’s not feasible, please propose a date.

Quick ask at the top: what is your Type II audit period?

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: SOC2_Evidence_Request_Template.xlsx)
(Attachment: transfer_instructions.txt)
From: Amelia Nguyen <amelia.nguyen@acmecloud.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 14:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report & bridge options — audit period clarification

Hi Diego — thanks for the clear note.

We currently have a SOC 2 Type II report covering the period Jul 1 2026 — Jun 30 2027. We can provide a bridge letter (management assertion) to extend stated coverage through Dec 31 2027; that is a standard offering and we can issue a dated bridge letter.

A couple of quick clarifying questions before we package everything: 
1) Scope: do you need production-only coverage, or do you also require non-production (staging/dev) environment controls included?
2) Redaction: are there any PII or legal redaction constraints we should follow beyond standard redaction of customer names?
3) Transfer method: we can deliver via an encrypted S3 presigned URL. Please confirm the recipient email and whether you require server-side encryption with KMS.

We expect to have the report PDF and bridge letter available for secure transfer by Mon, 2028-03-06 if you confirm scope and transfer method today. Control matrices and policy snapshots may take an extra day depending on redaction needs.

Contact for transfer: security-uploads@acmecloud.com (S3 presigned)

If you’d like, we can also provide a short redaction stub listing the fields we will redact so your legal team can review.

Best,
Amelia Nguyen
Director, Trust & Security
Acme Cloud Services
(Attachment: internal_transfer_instructions.pdf)

Folks — forwarding Amelia’s reply. We need a quick internal decision on two items so I can lock the delivery plan:

1) Scope: Monica, can you confirm whether Product requires production-only certification or also staging/dev? Our compliance team prefers production-only but enterprise customers sometimes ask for non-prod controls. We need the answer by EOD.

2) Redaction/legal: Marissa, please confirm whether our legal / procurement team needs a redaction stub or DPA before receiving the report. If yes, we’ll ask Amelia for their redaction list and escalate to legal.

Suggested reply (one-line or short) if you want to send directly to Amelia: 
"Thanks — production-only is fine; please deliver via encrypted S3 presigned link to security@redwood.com and include the bridge letter dated Dec 31 2027."

I’ve dropped a short set of reply snippets and our S3 transfer info on Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/ACME-44321 (Attachment: one-line-replies.txt)

Diego

Hi Amelia — thanks for the quick turnaround and for offering the bridge letter. We confirm the following: 

- Scope: production-only coverage is acceptable for our review.
- Redaction: please perform standard redaction of customer names and system IPs only; do not redact control descriptions or test results. If you plan to redact more, please share the redaction stub first.
- Transfer method: encrypted S3 presigned link to security@redwood.com is preferred. Please use server-side encryption (AES256) — KMS is optional.

Requested artifacts to include in the transfer:
1) SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
2) Bridge letter / management assertion (PDF) dated Dec 31 2027
3) Control matrices / evidence index (xlsx)
4) Policy snapshots (PDF) — redacted per guidance above

Target delivery: Mon, 2028-03-06 is perfect. If anything changes, please reply to this thread or send the presigned URL to security@redwood.com.

Thanks again — we’ll pick up the paperwork side if your team needs an NDA/DPA before transfer.

Diego Fernandez
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: one-line-replies.txt)
